Swaps Where branches and removes or preserves the matched Not.

class UnsqueezeEqualPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <where_pattern.h>

Moves Equal(x, c) after a compatible sibling Unsqueeze(x, a) and preserves the rank of Equal(Unsqueeze(x, a), Unsqueeze(y, a)).

Before (upstream form):
                   +-----------+
  x, axes=a -----> | Unsqueeze | ---> ux
                   +-----------+

            +-------+
  x, c ---> | Equal | ---> q
            +-------+
                 |
                 v
            +-----------+
  axes=a -> | Unsqueeze | ---> z
            +-----------+

After (upstream form):
                   +-----------+
  x, axes=a -----> | Unsqueeze | ---> ux
                   +-----------+

            +-------+
  ux, c --> | Equal | ---> z
            +-------+

Before (local form):
                   +-----------+
  x, axes=a -----> | Unsqueeze | ---> ux
                   +-----------+

                   +-----------+
  y, axes=a -----> | Unsqueeze | ---> uy
                   +-----------+

             +-------+
  ux, uy --> | Equal | ---> z
             +-------+

After (local form):
            +-------+
  x, y ---> | Equal | ---> q
            +-------+

                 +-----------+
  q, axes=a ---> | Unsqueeze | ---> z
                 +-----------+

All axes are equal constant tensors. The upstream form requires a rank-zero c unless inferred shapes prove that Equal(x,c) preserves x’s rank. The local form requires equal pre-Unsqueeze ranks and unshared expanded inputs.

Public Functions

inline explicit UnsqueezeEqualPattern(int priority = 0)#

Creates the pattern with the given optimization priority.

virtual std::set<std::string> FastOpType() const override#

Returns Equal as the only possible root operator.

virtual core::builder::MatchResult Match(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const NodeProto &candidate) const override#

Finds an upstream or local Equal/Unsqueeze topology.

virtual utils::RepeatedProtoField<NodeProto> Apply(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const std::vector<const NodeProto*> &nodes) const override#

Rebuilds the topology without changing the final output rank.

class WhereAddPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <where_pattern.h>

Rewrites an additive mask or factors a common term from Where branches.

Before (mask form):
                 +-------+
  c, 0, -inf --> | Where | ---> w
                 +-------+

            +-----+
  w, k ---> | Add | ---> y
            +-----+

After (mask form):
                  +-------+
  c, k, -inf ---> | Where | ---> y
                  +-------+

Before (factoring form):
            +-----+
  a, z ---> | Add | ---> then
            +-----+

            +-----+
  b, z ---> | Add | ---> else
            +-----+

                    +-------+
  c, then, else --> | Where | ---> y
                    +-------+

After (factoring form):
               +-------+
  c, a, b ---> | Where | ---> w
               +-------+

            +-----+
  w, z ---> | Add | ---> y
            +-----+

The mask form requires an unshared Where output and accepts either operand order for Add. The factoring form requires both branch Add outputs to be unshared and recognizes the common input in either position.

Public Functions

inline explicit WhereAddPattern(int priority = 0)#

Creates the pattern with the given optimization priority.

virtual std::set<std::string> FastOpType() const override#

Returns Where as the only possible root operator.

virtual core::builder::MatchResult Match(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const NodeProto &candidate) const override#

Finds an additive mask or two Add branches sharing one input.

virtual utils::RepeatedProtoField<NodeProto> Apply(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const std::vector<const NodeProto*> &nodes) const override#

Emits the upstream Where or the local factored Where and Add.

         +--------+

       +-----------+

After:
                   +-----------+
  c, axes=[0] ---> | Unsqueeze | ---> uc
                   +-----------+
                         |
                         v
                      +--------+
  x ----------------> | Binary | ---> y
                      +--------+

class TransposeReshapeTransposePattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <layout_pattern.h>

Moves a constant Reshape across one of two adjacent Transpose nodes when the input and target dimensions can be aligned by merging or splitting contiguous dimensions.

Before:
         +-------------------+
  x ---> | Transpose [1,0,2] | ---> t0
         +-------------------+
                    |
                    v
               +---------+
               | Reshape | <--- [6,4]
               +---------+
                    |
                    v
             +-----------------+
             | Transpose [1,0] | ---> y
             +-----------------+

After:
         +-------------------+
  x ---> | Transpose [1,0,2] | ---> t0
         +-------------------+
                    |
                    v
             +-------------------+
             | Transpose [2,0,1] | ---> t1
             +-------------------+
                    |
                    v
               +---------+
               | Reshape | <--- [4,6]
               +---------+
                    |
                    v
                    y

Before (dual rank-expanding form):
         +-----------+
  x ---> | Transpose | ---> t0
         +-----------+
               |
               v
          +---------+
          | Reshape | ---> r
          +---------+
               |
               v
         +-----------+
         | Transpose | ---> y
         +-----------+

After (dual rank-expanding form):
                 +---------+
  x, target ---> | Reshape | ---> r
                 +---------+
                      |
                      v
               +--------------------+
               | Remapped Transpose | ---> y
               +--------------------+

In the dual rank-expanding case, the first Transpose is removed and the Reshape is moved before a remapped Transpose; the final Transpose and output are retained.

class GemmTransposePattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <matmul_pattern.h>

Exposes a constant Gemm weight transpose while preserving Gemm semantics.

Before:
                                 +---------------+
  A, B constant, optional C ---> | Gemm transB=0 | ---> y
                                 +---------------+

After:
         +-----------------+
  B ---> | Transpose [1,0] | ---> Bt
         +-----------------+

                       +---------------+
  A, Bt, optional C -> | Gemm transB=1 | ---> y
                       +---------------+

The original Gemm must have transA=0, transB=0, and beta=1. The explicit transpose can subsequently be folded into the constant.

class MatMulAddPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <matmul_pattern.h>

Fuses an Add bias into a MatMul or Gemm.

Before:
                        +-------------+
  A, B, optional C ---> | MatMul/Gemm | ---> m
                        +-------------+

              +-----+
  m, bias --> | Add | ---> y
              +-----+

After (rank-two A):
                      +-----+
  optional C, bias -> | Add | ---> combined bias
                      +-----+

                         +------+
  A, B, combined bias -> | Gemm | ---> y
                         +------+

Without C, bias feeds the boxed Gemm directly.

After (higher-rank A):
         +-------------------+
  A ---> | Reshape to rank 2 | ---> Ar
         +-------------------+

           +-------------------+
  bias --> | Reshape if needed | ---> gemm bias
           +-------------------+

                      +------+
  Ar, B, gemm bias -> | Gemm | ---> t
                      +------+

              +-----------------------+
  t, shape -> | Reshape to final rank | ---> y
              +-----------------------+

The bias last dimension must match the output width. For a higher-rank left input, when enabled, the rewrite flattens it to rank two, applies Gemm, and restores the output shape; a higher-rank bias is flattened as needed.

Public Functions

class MatMulReshape2Of3Pattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <matmul_pattern.h>

Normalizes adjacent Reshapes around a MatMul to the final batch shape.

Before:
         +----------+
  A ---> | Reshape? | ---> rA
         +----------+

         +----------+
  B ---> | Reshape? | ---> rB
         +----------+

              +--------------------+
  rA, rB ---> | MatMul/FusedMatMul | ---> m
              +--------------------+
                         |
                         v
                    +----------+
                    | Reshape? | ---> y
                    +----------+

At least two of the three optional Reshape nodes are present.

After:
         +-------------------+
  A ---> | Reshape if needed | ---> rA
         +-------------------+

         +-------------------+
  B ---> | Reshape if needed | ---> rB
         +-------------------+

              +--------------------+
  rA, rB ---> | MatMul/FusedMatMul | ---> y
              +--------------------+

A boxed restoring Reshape is emitted when the intermediate MatMul shape is
still required.

All participating shapes must be static, preserve element counts and the last two matrix dimensions, and describe equal batch element counts. Shared pre-Reshapes are retained for their other consumers. If the old MatMul result also needs its intermediate shape, a restoring Reshape is emitted.

class MulMulMatMulPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <matmul_pattern.h>

Moves scalar factors from both MatMul inputs to one multiplication after the MatMul.

Before:
             +-----+
  x, c1 ---> | Mul | ---> mx
             +-----+

             +-----+
  z, c2 ---> | Mul | ---> mz
             +-----+

             +--------+
  mx, mz --> | MatMul | ---> y
             +--------+

After:
            +--------+
  x, z ---> | MatMul | ---> t
            +--------+

                         +-----+
  t, combined scalar --> | Mul | ---> y
                         +-----+

Each input Mul must contain exactly one scalar constant and have an unshared output. The constants are multiplied into one initializer.

class ReshapeMatMulReshapePattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <matmul_pattern.h>

Removes batch-flattening Reshapes around a MatMul.

Before:
         +-------------------+
  A ---> | Reshape to rank 3 | ---> rA
         +-------------------+

         +-------------------+
  B ---> | Reshape to rank 3 | ---> rB
         +-------------------+

              +--------+
  rA, rB ---> | MatMul | ---> m
              +--------+
                  |
                  v
          +--------------------------+
          | Reshape to original rank | ---> y
          +--------------------------+

After:
  A ---------------------+
                         |
                         v
                     +--------+
                     | MatMul | ---> y
                     +--------+
                         ^
  B ---------------------+

The original inputs and final output have equal rank of at least four. Reshapes must preserve element counts and matrix suffixes, and the original batch prefixes must broadcast directly to the final shape. Shared input Reshapes are retained for their other consumers.

class ShapeBasedMatMulToMulPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <matmul_pattern.h>

Replaces a MatMul with unit reduction dimensions by element-wise Mul.

Before:
            +-----------------------+
  A, B ---> | MatMul unit reduction | ---> m
            +-----------------------+
                  |
                  v
          +----------------------+
          | Optional Transpose   | ---> y
          | swapping last 2 axes |
          +----------------------+

After (no Transpose):
            +-----+
  A, B ---> | Mul | ---> y
            +-----+

After (last-two Transpose present):
         +------------------+
  A ---> | Reshape ...,1,-1 | ---> rA
         +------------------+

         +------------------+
  B ---> | Reshape ...,-1,1 | ---> rB
         +------------------+

             +-----+
  rA, rB --> | Mul | ---> y
             +-----+

The last dimension of A and penultimate dimension of B must both be one. A following last-two-dimension Transpose is removed only when both input ranks exceed two.

class SwitchReshapeActivationPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <matmul_pattern.h>

Moves an element-wise activation before a Reshape or Transpose.

Before:
            +-------------+
  A, B ---> | MatMul/Gemm | ---> m
            +-------------+
                  |
                  v
          +-------------------+
          | Reshape/Transpose | ---> l
          +-------------------+
                  |
                  v
             +------------+
             | Activation | ---> y
             +------------+

After:
            +-------------+
  A, B ---> | MatMul/Gemm | ---> m
            +-------------+
                  |
                  v
             +------------+
             | Activation | ---> a
             +------------+
                  |
                  v
          +-------------------+
          | Reshape/Transpose | ---> y
          +-------------------+

Layout is a Reshape or Transpose. Its input and output must be unshared, so the activation can commute across the layout without changing other consumers.

class TransposeMatMulPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <matmul_pattern.h>

Absorbs rank-two input Transposes into Gemm transpose attributes.

Before:
         +------------------------+
  A ---> | Optional Transpose 1,0 | ---> At
         +------------------------+

         +------------------------+
  B ---> | Optional Transpose 1,0 | ---> Bt
         +------------------------+

                         +-------------+
                                  +-------------+
  A or At, B or Bt, optional C -> | MatMul/Gemm | ---> y
                                  +-------------+

At least one boxed Transpose is present.

After:
                        +------------------------+
  A, B, optional C ---> | Gemm toggled transA/B  | ---> y
                        +------------------------+

At least one input must be transposed. Existing Gemm flags are toggled for the absorbed sides; shared Transposes are retained, and on GPU a shared side is not absorbed.

class TransposeReshapeMatMulPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <matmul_pattern.h>

Swaps a last-two-dimension Transpose with a following Reshape on one MatMul input.

Before:
         +-----------------------+
  A ---> | Transpose last 2 axes | ---> t
         +-----------------------+
                    |
                    v
               +---------+
               | Reshape | <--- matrix-preserving target
               +---------+
                    |
                    +-----------------------+
                                            |
                                            v
                                         +--------+
  B -----------------------------------> | MatMul | ---> y
                                         +--------+

After:
         +------------------------+
  A ---> | Reshape swapped target | ---> r
         +------------------------+
                    |
                    v
             +-----------------------+
             | Transpose last 2 axes |
             +-----------------------+
                    |
                    +-----------------------+
                                            |
                                            v
                                         +--------+
  B -----------------------------------> | MatMul | ---> y
                                         +--------+

The same rewrite may be applied to the right MatMul input.

The selected Reshape target must be constant and preserve the transposed matrix suffix. Both intermediate outputs must be unshared. The same rewrite may be applied to the right input instead.

namespace onnx_light

Alias that makes onnx-light headers compatible with code that references ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE (the macro used in the standard onnx package).

Set to ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE so both names resolve to the same namespace.

Symbol-visibility attribute for the public onnx-light C++ API.

Maps the upstream compatibility macro to onnx-light’s explicit proto ABI annotation. This keeps declarations from vendored ONNX headers visible when lib_onnx_proto uses hidden visibility by default.

Namespace alias so that ONNX C++ code (and consumers such as onnxruntime) that refers to the literal onnx namespace — rather than the ONNX_NAMESPACE macro — resolves to the onnx-light namespace. The standard onnx package lives in namespace onnx; onnx-light uses onnx_light (via ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE), so this alias keeps onnx-light a true drop-in. It is only introduced when the onnx-light namespace differs from onnx.

class GeluPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <activation_pattern.h>

Fuses the tanh approximation of Gelu.

Before:
              +-----+
  x, three -->| Pow |----> powered
              +-----+
                               +-----+
  powered, cubic coefficient ->| Mul |----> cubic
                               +-----+
              +-----+
  x, cubic -->| Add |----> polynomial
              +-----+
                           +-----+
  polynomial, tanh scale ->| Mul |----> scaled polynomial
                           +-----+
                        +------+
  scaled polynomial --->| Tanh |----> tanh value
                        +------+
                    +-----+
  tanh value, one ->| Add |----> tanh term
                    +-----+
                  +-----+
  x, one half --->| Mul |----> half input
                  +-----+
                          +-----+
  half input, tanh term ->| Mul |----> y
                          +-----+

After:
         +------+
  x ---->| Gelu |----> y
         +------+

The replacement uses approximate="tanh". The cubic coefficient may also be the float16 value 0.044708251953125; its usual value is 0.044715. The exponent, tanh scale, final offset, and input scale are respectively 3, 0.7978515625, 1, and 0.5. All decomposition intermediates must be unshared, and the configured default-domain opset minimum must be met.

class SoftmaxCrossEntropyLossCastPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <activation_pattern.h>

Fuses a float16 mean cross-entropy loss decomposition.

Before:
                   +-------+       +-----+
  labels, -100 --->| Equal |------>| Not |----> valid
                   +-------+       +-----+

                              +-------+       +-----------+
  valid, labels, zero_i64 --->| Where |------>| Unsqueeze |----> gather indices
                              +-------+       +-----------+

             +------------+
  scores --->| LogSoftmax |----> log probabilities
             +------------+

                                      +----------------+       +---------+
  log probabilities, gather indices ->| GatherElements |------>| Squeeze |
                                      +----------------+       +---------+
                                                                   |
                                                                   v
                                                                +-----+
                                                                | Neg |---> losses
                                                                +-----+

                            +-------+
  valid, losses, zero_f16 ->| Where |----> masked losses
                            +-------+

                    +------+       +-----------+       +------+
  masked losses --->| Cast |------>| ReduceSum |------>| Cast |----> numerator
                    +------+       +-----------+       +------+

             +------+       +-----------+       +------+
  valid ---->| Cast |------>| ReduceSum |------>| Cast |----> denominator
             +------+       +-----------+       +------+

                           +-----+
  numerator, denominator ->| Div |----> loss
                           +-----+

After:
                    +-------------------------+
  scores, labels -->| SoftmaxCrossEntropyLoss |----> loss
                    +-------------------------+

LogSoftmax, GatherElements, Unsqueeze, and Squeeze use axis one. Scores, masked losses, and the result must be float16; labels and the index zero must be int64. The reduction inputs are cast to float, both reductions use keepdims=0, and their results are cast back to float16. The fused loss uses ignore_index=-100 and reduction="mean".

class BatchNormalizationPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <normalization_pattern.h>

Removes an identity BatchNormalization in inference mode.

Before:
                                       +--------------------+
  x, scale, bias, mean, variance ----->| BatchNormalization |----> y
                                       +--------------------+

After:
         +----------+
  x ---->| Identity |----> y
         +----------+

Scale and variance must be constant ones; bias and mean must be constant zeros. Epsilon is zero, training mode is disabled, and running-statistic outputs must be unused.

class BatchNormalizationTrainingPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <normalization_pattern.h>

Expands training BatchNormalization into primitive operators.

Before:
                                                   +--------------------+
  x, scale, bias, running mean, running variance ->| BatchNormalization |----> y
                                                   +--------------------+

After:
         +------------+
  x ---->| ReduceMean |----> mean
         +------------+
              +-----+
  x, mean --->| Sub |----> centered
              +-----+
                         +-----+       +------------+
  centered, centered --->| Mul |------>| ReduceMean |----> variance
                         +-----+       +------------+
                                            |
                                            v
                                 +-----+       +------+
                      epsilon -->| Add |------>| Sqrt |----> deviation
                                 +-----+       +------+
                                    ^
                                    |
                                variance

                          +-----+
  centered, deviation --->| Div |----> normalized
                          +-----+

           +---------+
  scale -->| Reshape |----> broadcast scale
           +---------+
                                +-----+
  normalized, broadcast scale ->| Mul |----> scaled
                                +-----+
          +---------+
  bias -->| Reshape |----> broadcast bias
          +---------+
                           +-----+
  scaled, broadcast bias ->| Add |----> y
                           +-----+

The rewrite requires opset 18, a known input rank of at least two, known scale and bias ranks, and unused running-statistic outputs. Both ReduceMean nodes reduce every axis except channel axis 1. Reshape is emitted only for rank-one scale or bias inputs.

#include <normalization_pattern.h>

Moves a normalization from its stash type back to the original element type.

Before:
         +------+                    +---------------+       +------+
  x ---->| Cast |----> promoted ---->| Normalization |------>| Cast |----> y
         +------+                    +---------------+       +------+
                                         ^
                                         |
                                   scale, bias, ...

After:
                      +------+
  scale, bias, ... -->| Cast |----> converted parameters
                      +------+

                            +---------------+
  x, converted parameters ->| Normalization |----> y
                            +---------------+

The normalization may be GroupNormalization, LayerNormalization, RMSNormalization, or SimplifiedLayerNormalization in the ONNX or Microsoft domain. A separate Cast is emitted for every non-data input. Optional outputs must be unused, and both outer Cast results must be exclusive to the chain.

class LayerNormalizationPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <normalization_pattern.h>

Fuses an explicit layer-normalization decomposition.

Before:
         +------------+
  x ---->| ReduceMean |----> mean
         +------------+

              +-----+
  x, mean --->| Sub |----> centered
              +-----+
                  +-----+
  centered, two ->| Pow |----> squared
                  +-----+
            +------------+
  squared ->| ReduceMean |----> variance
            +------------+
                      +-----+       +------+
  variance, epsilon ->| Add |------>| Sqrt |----> deviation
                      +-----+       +------+

                          +-----+
  centered, deviation --->| Div |----> y
                          +-----+

  Alternate final path:
               +------------+
  deviation -->| Reciprocal |----> inverse
               +------------+
                           +-----+
  centered, inverse ------>| Mul |----> y
                           +-----+

After:
         +-------+
  x ---->| Shape |----> normalized shape
         +-------+

                      +-----------------+
  normalized shape -->| ConstantOfShape |----> scale
                      +-----------------+
                      +-----------------+
  normalized shape -->| ConstantOfShape |----> bias
                      +-----------------+

                     +--------------------+
  x, scale, bias --->| LayerNormalization |----> y
                     +--------------------+

Both means must keep dimensions and reduce the same trailing axes. All removed intermediates must be unshared. Scale and bias are initializers when the final dimension is static; otherwise the shown Shape branches create one and zero tensors.

class LayerNormalizationScalePattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <normalization_pattern.h>

Folds a following affine transform into LayerNormalization parameters.

Before:
                    +--------------------+
  x, scale, bias -->| LayerNormalization |----> normalized
                    +--------------------+

                              +-----+                       +-----+
  normalized, extra scale --->| Mul |----> scaled --------->| Add |----> y
                              +-----+                       +-----+
                                                               ^
                                                               |
                                                          extra bias

After:
                          +-----+
  scale, extra scale ---->| Mul |----> new scale
                          +-----+

                          +-----+                    +-----+
  bias, extra scale ----->| Mul |----> scaled bias ->| Add |----> new bias
                          +-----+                    +-----+
                                                         ^
                                                         |
                                                    extra bias

                           +--------------------+
  x, new scale, new bias ->| LayerNormalization |----> y
                           +--------------------+

The extra scale, optional bias, and original scale must have equal shapes. The normalization and Mul outputs must not have unrelated consumers. Parameter Mul or Add nodes are omitted when an existing unit scale or a missing bias makes them unnecessary.

#include <normalization_pattern.h>

Folds a constant post-scale into RMSNormalization.

Before:
               +------------------+

               +------------------+
                             +-----+
  normalized, scale2 ------->| Mul |----> y

After:

class RMSNormalizationPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <normalization_pattern.h>

Fuses an explicit root-mean-square normalization decomposition.

Before:
  Optional input conversion:
         +------+
  x ---->| Cast |----> z
         +------+

           +-----+
  z, two ->| Pow |----> squared
           +-----+
            +------------+
  squared ->| ReduceMean |----> mean square
            +------------+
                           +-----+       +------+
  mean square, epsilon --->| Add |------>| Sqrt |----> deviation
                           +-----+       +------+

               +------------+
  deviation -->| Reciprocal |----> inverse
               +------------+

  Alternate inverse path:
                     +-----+
  one, deviation --->| Div |----> inverse
                     +-----+

               +-----+
  z, inverse ->| Mul |----> normalized
               +-----+

  Optional output conversion:
               +------+
  normalized ->| Cast |----> y
               +------+

After:
         +-------+       +-----------------+
  x ---->| Shape |------>| ConstantOfShape |----> scale
         +-------+       +-----------------+

              +------------------+
  x, scale -->| RMSNormalization |----> y
              +------------------+

The optional Cast pair must convert to the reduction stash type and restore the original type. The rewrite requires opset 23, suffix reduction axes, and unshared intermediates. The scale is a static initializer when its shape is known; otherwise the shown Shape branch creates an all-ones tensor.

Public Functions

Returns the match rooted at candidate. A null pattern means no match.

class ConcatReshapePattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <reshape_pattern.h>

Replaces dynamic dimensions in a concatenated Reshape target with one inferred dimension.

Before:
                                   +--------+
  constant, dynamic, Shape dims -> | Concat | ---> target
                                   +--------+

                +---------+
  x, target --> | Reshape | ---> y
                +---------+

After:
                                +--------+
  constant, [-1], Shape dims -> | Concat | ---> target2
                                +--------+

                 +---------+
  x, target2 --> | Reshape | ---> y
                 +---------+

Every non-Shape dynamic slot is replaced by [-1]; when all dynamic slots come from Shape, the last such slot is replaced. Dynamic inputs must each describe one dimension and the target may contain only one inferred dimension. A shared original Concat is retained for its other consumers.

After:

class Reshape2Of3Pattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <reshape_pattern.h>

Moves a binary operation to the common outer shape represented by surrounding Reshapes.

Before:
         +----------+
  x ---> | Reshape? | ---> rx
         +----------+

         +----------+
  z ---> | Reshape? | ---> rz
         +----------+

              +--------+
  rx, rz ---> | Binary | ---> b
              +--------+
                  |
                  v
             +----------+
             | Reshape? | ---> y
             +----------+

At least two of the three optional Reshape nodes are present.

After:
         +-------------------+
  x ---> | Reshape if needed | ---> rx
         +-------------------+

         +-------------------+
  z ---> | Reshape if needed | ---> rz
         +-------------------+

              +--------+
  rx, rz ---> | Binary | ---> t
              +--------+
                  |
                  v
          +-------------------+
          | Reshape if needed | ---> y
          +-------------------+

The binary operation must not broadcast, and the available source/final shapes must be equal. Existing input Reshapes are removed; a missing input Reshape or output Reshape is inserted only when needed to preserve the original output shape. Shared input Reshapes are retained for their other consumers.

namespace onnx_patterns
class TreeEnsemblePattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <tree_ensemble_pattern.h>

Replaces classic TreeEnsembleRegressor and TreeEnsembleClassifier nodes with the unified ai.onnx.ml TreeEnsemble operator from opset 5.

Before (regressor):
         +-----------------------+
  x ---> | TreeEnsembleRegressor | ---> y
         +-----------------------+

After (regressor):
         +--------------+
  x ---> | TreeEnsemble | ---> y
         +--------------+

After (regressor with base values):
         +--------------+
  x ---> | TreeEnsemble | ---> tree scores
         +--------------+

                             +-----+
  tree scores, base values -> | Add | ---> y
                             +-----+

Before (classifier):
         +------------------------+
  x ---> | TreeEnsembleClassifier | ---> labels, scores
         +------------------------+

After (classifier with integer labels):
         +--------------+
  x ---> | TreeEnsemble | ---> scores
         +--------------+
                   |
                   v
              +--------+
              | ArgMax | ---> indices
              +--------+
                   |
                   v
              +--------+
  labels ---> | Gather | ---> labels output
              +--------+

After (classifier with string labels):
         +--------------+
  x ---> | TreeEnsemble | ---> scores
         +--------------+
                   |
                   v
              +--------+
              | ArgMax | ---> indices
              +--------+
                   |
                   v
            +--------------+
            | LabelEncoder | ---> labels output
            +--------------+

The rewrite applies to FLOAT ensembles already imported with ai.onnx.ml opset 5, using SUM aggregation and no post-transform. Classifier labels are reconstructed with ArgMax followed by Gather for integer labels or by LabelEncoder for string labels. Base values insert Add between TreeEnsemble and its final numeric output when the default-domain opset supports multidirectional broadcasting.

Public Functions

Creates the pattern with the given optimization priority.

Returns the two classic tree ensemble operators as possible roots.

virtual core::builder::MatchResult Match(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const NodeProto &candidate) const override#

Finds a classic tree ensemble whose semantics are representable by opset 5.

virtual utils::RepeatedProtoField<NodeProto> Apply(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const std::vector<const NodeProto*> &nodes) const override#

Replaces the classic operator with TreeEnsemble and output adapter nodes.

namespace onnx_patterns
class TransposeGatherPattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <transpose_pattern.h>

Removes an unnecessary Transpose feeding a Gather with a scalar index.

Before:
         +-------------------+
  x ---> | Transpose [2,0,1] | ---> t
         +-------------------+
                    |
                    v
             +--------------+
             | Gather axis0 | <--- scalar k
             +--------------+
                    |
                    v
                    y

After (remaining permutation is sorted):
                   +--------------+
  x, scalar k ---> | Gather axis2 | ---> y
                   +--------------+

After (remaining permutation is not sorted):
                   +--------------+
  x, scalar k ---> | Gather axis2 | ---> g
                   +--------------+
                          |
                          v
                 +-----------------+
                 | Transpose [1,0] | ---> y
                 +-----------------+

When the remaining permutation is no longer sorted the rewrite gathers on the original tensor first and transposes the smaller result. For example, Transpose(x,[1,2,0]) followed by scalar Gather(axis=1) becomes Gather(x,axis=2) followed by Transpose([1,0]). The original Transpose is preserved when its output is consumed elsewhere.

Public Functions

inline explicit TransposeGatherPattern(int priority = 0)#

Creates the pattern with the given optimization priority.

virtual std::set<std::string> FastOpType() const override#

Returns Gather as the only possible root operator.

virtual core::builder::MatchResult Match(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const NodeProto &candidate) const override#

Finds a Gather with a scalar index fed by a default-domain Transpose.

virtual utils::RepeatedProtoField<NodeProto> Apply(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const std::vector<const NodeProto*> &nodes) const override#

Rewrites the matched pair, swapping the Transpose past the Gather.

class TransposeTransposePattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <transpose_pattern.h>

Merges two consecutive Transpose nodes into a single one.

Before:
         +-------------------+
  x ---> | Transpose [1,0,2] | ---> t
         +-------------------+
                    |
                    v
             +-------------------+
             | Transpose [0,2,1] | ---> y
             +-------------------+

After:
         +-------------------+
  x ---> | Transpose [1,2,0] | ---> y
         +-------------------+

After (identity composed permutation):
         +----------+
  x ---> | Identity | ---> y
         +----------+

When the composed permutation is the identity the pair is replaced by an Identity node. The first Transpose is preserved when its output is consumed elsewhere; in that case the rewrite only applies when the composed permutation is the identity, so no additional Transpose is introduced.

Finds a Transpose followed by another default-domain Transpose.

Unsqueeze

namespace onnx_light

Alias that makes onnx-light headers compatible with code that references ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE (the macro used in the standard onnx package).

Set to ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE so both names resolve to the same namespace.

Symbol-visibility attribute for the public onnx-light C++ API.

Maps the upstream compatibility macro to onnx-light’s explicit proto ABI annotation. This keeps declarations from vendored ONNX headers visible when lib_onnx_proto uses hidden visibility by default.

Namespace alias so that ONNX C++ code (and consumers such as onnxruntime) that refers to the literal onnx namespace — rather than the ONNX_NAMESPACE macro — resolves to the onnx-light namespace. The standard onnx package lives in namespace onnx; onnx-light uses onnx_light (via ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE), so this alias keeps onnx-light a true drop-in. It is only introduced when the onnx-light namespace differs from onnx.

namespace onnx_patterns
class SqueezeUnsqueezePattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <unsqueeze_pattern.h>

Simplifies a Squeeze/Unsqueeze pair into Identity or Squeeze.

Before:
                   +-----------+
  x, axes=[1] ---> | Unsqueeze | ---> t
                   +-----------+
                         |
                         v
                    +---------+
                    | Squeeze | <--- axes=[1]
                    +---------+
                         |
                         v
                         y

After (matching axes):
         +----------+
  x ---> | Identity | ---> y
         +----------+

After (the following Squeeze removes additional axes):
                        +---------+
  x, adjusted axes ---> | Squeeze | ---> y
                        +---------+

The inverse Squeeze-then-Unsqueeze order is also matched.

The two nodes must be a Squeeze and an Unsqueeze (in either order). Equal axes collapse to Identity (multiple axes must be contiguous). If the first node is an Unsqueeze whose axes are a strict subset of the following Squeeze, the pair collapses to a single Squeeze on the adjusted remaining axes; for example, Unsqueeze(x,[1]) then Squeeze([1,3]) becomes Squeeze(x,[2]). The first node is preserved when its output is consumed elsewhere.

Public Functions

inline explicit SqueezeUnsqueezePattern(int priority = 0)#

Creates the pattern with the given optimization priority.

virtual std::set<std::string> FastOpType() const override#

Returns Squeeze and Unsqueeze as the possible root operators.

virtual core::builder::MatchResult Match(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const NodeProto &candidate) const override#

Finds a Squeeze/Unsqueeze pair feeding an Unsqueeze/Squeeze.

virtual utils::RepeatedProtoField<NodeProto> Apply(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const std::vector<const NodeProto*> &nodes) const override#

Replaces the matched pair with an Identity or a single Squeeze.

class UnsqueezeUnsqueezePattern : public onnx_light::core::builder::PatternOptimization#
#include <unsqueeze_pattern.h>

Merges two consecutive Unsqueeze nodes into a single one.

Before:
                   +-----------+
  x, axes=[1] ---> | Unsqueeze | ---> t
                   +-----------+
                         |
                         v
                  +-----------+
                  | Unsqueeze | <--- axes=[0]
                  +-----------+
                         |
                         v
                         y

After:
                     +-----------+
  x, axes=[0,2] ---> | Unsqueeze | ---> y
                     +-----------+

Both axes inputs must be scalar or one-dimensional non-negative constants. When one of the two nodes inserts more than one axis the rank of the source tensor must be known so the combined axes can be computed. The first Unsqueeze is preserved when its output is consumed elsewhere.

Public Functions

inline explicit UnsqueezeUnsqueezePattern(int priority = 0)#

Creates the pattern with the given optimization priority.

Returns Unsqueeze as the only possible root operator.

Finds an Unsqueeze feeding another default-domain Unsqueeze.

virtual utils::RepeatedProtoField<NodeProto> Apply(core::builder::GraphGraph &graph, const std::vector<const NodeProto*> &nodes) const override#

Replaces the matched pair with a single Unsqueeze.
